capabilities.description: Compute and monitor real-time operational readiness across runways, gates, stands, terminals, and ground service equipment, flagging degraded assets and scheduling issues.
Provide a live operational dashboard of flight activity, resource status, and alerts for airside controllers and duty managers.
Coordinate ground handling tasks, work orders, and team assignments across turnaround, baggage, fueling, and maintenance workflows.
Manage airport manuals, operating certificates, safety directives, and controlled documents with versioning, validation, and audit trails.
Capture, hash, and verify incident reports, photos, and sensor logs for safety investigations and regulatory reporting.
Process flight, weather, and operational events to trigger notifications, updates, and downstream workflows across the platform.
Answer ops and compliance questions from airport documentation, procedures, and historical records using search and AI-assisted recommendations.

summary: An integrated operations platform for airport authorities and airside teams that unifies flight, resource, and readiness data into a single command view. It tracks aircraft turnarounds, gate and stand allocation, ground crew dispatch, work orders, regulatory documents, and incident evidence to keep daily airport operations safe, compliant, and on schedule.
